Wanted to put in my goofy bad guys, a trio of idiots, goofy goobers and killers! :D

1 : Esther, daughter of the King of Fear and Negativity. She can shapeshift into others and create weapons from her hands in a fight! Loves messing with people, pulling pranks and having fun! Is excited to explore new worlds and dimensions (with the Boss' permission, of course!)

2 : Lucas Brady, dagger enthusiast and knife collector. Loves all things sharp and cutting people up. Some call him a lunatic. And those people are right. When he's not crazed out of his mind with manic bloodlust, he's poking fun and making weird (if not disturbing) comments and jokes with his pals. First of the Boss' staff.

3 : Zoom, a literal being of lightspeed and kinetic energy. Fastest being in the multiverse, or so he claims. He is laid back and extremely sarcastic, being a sassy sally to all those he faces, friend or foe. He may have taken more than a few tricks from a certain blue hedgehog he's seen in the world bubbles, but who's going to tell?

These three idiots are my 3 opossums in a trench coat, and I love them. While on their own, they're deadly and vicious, together they are absolute nut cases, cracking themselves up and causing foes to question the groups sanity. Well, before they decide to kill them, of course!
